scope: Public-only exploratory real-price backtests; a limited step toward the requested global crisis study
observation: The user has only public/free data access. A read-only Yahoo endpoint probe returned pre-2008 stock history. Canonical point-in-time global membership and delisting data remain absent.
hypothesized_cause: A separately disclosed retrospective sample can test the implemented model on actual historical prices while preserving the limitations of public revised survivor data.
decision: Predeclare 24 named stocks across 12 listing markets, six monthly crisis/recovery windows, four models and seed 11 in configs/public_equity_crises.json. Use a distinct public research-window adapter and local-currency hypothetical stock ledgers without altering canonical panel admission or claiming historical publication timestamps, all-world coverage or global portfolio performance.
predicted_effect: The bounded 24-cell campaign will produce actual historical conditional forecast and local-stock simulation evidence, including the 2008 crisis, if data completeness and resource checks pass.
discriminating_experiment: Use identical dated, maturity-purged training/validation/test rows for FREM, no_memory, ridge and xgboost. Keep every failed download, excluded coverage window, failed fit and unfavorable comparison. Use 12-month contexts with a blind month, five epochs, three-month bootstrap blocks and predeclared 10-bps-per-side hypothetical transaction costs.
result: DECLARED_BEFORE_CAMPAIGN_ACQUISITION_AND_MODEL_OUTCOMES; implementation and causal tests must pass before fitting.
